name: PhysioNetPhysiology: Network Physiology and Time-Delay-Stability Organ-Interaction Networks
description: Tools for Network Physiology: the study of dynamic interactions among diverse physiological systems (brain, heart, respiration, muscle). Implements Time Delay Stability (TDS) analysis, organ-interaction networks with surrogate-tested links, and state-resolved network reconfiguration. Methods follow Bashan et al. (2012) <doi:10.1038/ncomms1705> and Bartsch et al. (2015) <doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0142143>.
